name: W. B. Wright
role: Medora resident from the East; association secretary
bio: W. B. Wright arrived from New York with a Mr. Baird in April 1884, gave $50 for the injured Frank Walker in March 1885 and served as secretary of a church society formed that June. By December 1886 the paper listed him among old-timers, then living in Cromwell, Mass.

moments.label: Served as secretary of a new association
Listed as an old-timer now in Cromwell, Mass.
